name: Christian Crawford
source: src/app/globals.css (@theme) and src/lib/type.ts. Update this file when those change.

color.note: Values are the default (gray) theme. primary, secondary, accent, on-header and button-edge are driven by CSS custom properties that the color picker (src/components/ui/ColorPicker.tsx) rewrites. Use the tokens, never literal colors.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Theme color: the footer's solid band and the left stop of every gradient.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Right stop of every gradient. A fixed hue offset from primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The theme color as foreground on white: kickers, button labels, links, focus rings. Also the AI banner's fill. A deep shade of the hue (≥7.5:1 on white); ink on the white stop.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on white surfaces, and on-header on light (hue and white) themes.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: White sections and button fill. Sections paint it explicitly, since the page canvas underneath is the gradient.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and tiles set apart from a white section (FeaturePanel, DetailGrid).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: A third neutral for quiet fills. Defined but not currently used.

tokens.name: on-header
tokens.usage: Text and icons on colored grounds (header, gradients, primary band). White on gray/black, ink on hues and white. Nav labels sit at 80% opacity, full on hover/current.

tokens.name: button-edge
tokens.usage: Border of the surface-filled button. Ink on the white stop, where a white button would otherwise disappear.

gradients.name: bg-header-gradient
gradients.usage: Header bar and gradient panels; stops at 90% opacity.

type.note: Headings use the responsive class strings in src/lib/type.ts; sizes run smallest (mobile) to largest (2xl). All headings use text-balance.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Standalone statements and the mobile menu links.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Minor headings, tile and step titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Paragraph copy. Fixed at every breakpoint.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, tags. Fixed at every breakpoint.

spacing.name: space-1
spacing.usage: Tightest gap between closely related elements.

spacing.name: space-3
spacing.usage: Default grid gap and page gutter.

spacing.name: space-5
spacing.usage: Panel padding and gaps inside sections.

radius.name: radius-sm
radius.usage: Small controls: the skip link, the menu toggle, and the focus shape of the wordmark links.

radius.name: radius-circle
radius.usage: Icon badges and round icon buttons.

motion.name: ease-accordion
motion.usage: Open/close motion: the color picker panel, the mobile menu, and the menu toggle's bars.
